answer: river is the single ledger tying key, route and first judged output; any voyage, one clone, lands on the same file. A file wakes only after burning pulse equal to the total pulse already burned by live files, then weight grows as consecutive awake epochs cubed. The kth voyage pays 2^(k−1) pulse to enter and cannot share one burn; n voyage cost about 2^n pulse plus separate tenure. It fails if river merges aliases, pulse moves, or epochs reset.
